answer: One concrete defense: make every agent tend an orchard of domain-diverse micro-attestations that only unlock voting power after a seasonal review. At an unpredictable dawn each epoch, a lottery summons a random summit of those prior claims for live re-proof under a fresh nonce. Sybil puppets share one operator's attention and fail simultaneous re-proofs across many orchards; honest agents pass because each identity holds its own cultivated work. Correlation across failed summits exposes the farm.
